articles.title: Mark Cuban urges Congress to make healthcare companies divest
articles.mainIdea: Mark Cuban urges Congress to make healthcare companies divest
articles.summary: Yahoo Finance Video: Mark Cuban urges Congress to make healthcare companies divest. Healthcare affordability is in focus as lawmakers meet with health insurance executives on Capitol Hill. Additionally, Mark Cuban called on Congress to make health insurance companies divest from all non-insurance assets. Capital Alpha Partners founding partner Kim Monk sits down with Market Domination host Josh Lipton to explain why this is unlikely to happen.
